SELECT t_delivery_place.id, t_delivery_place.`status`, t_delivery_place.delivery_place_no AS deliveryPlaceNo, t_delivery_place.delivery_place_name AS deliveryPlaceName, t_delivery_place.delivery_place_class_no AS deliveryPlaceClassNo, t_delivery_place.delivery_place_class_name AS deliveryPlaceClassName, t_delivery_place.delivery_address AS deliveryAddress, t_delivery_place.contacts, t_delivery_place.contacts_telephone AS contactsTelephone, t_delivery_place.org_no AS orgNo, t_delivery_place.org_name AS orgName, t_delivery_place.dept_no AS deptNo, t_delivery_place.dept_name AS deptName FROM t_delivery_place WHERE t_delivery_place.is_deleted = #{param.deleted}
AND t_delivery_place.`status` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.status}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.delivery_place_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryPlaceNo}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.delivery_place_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryPlaceName}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.delivery_place_class_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryPlaceClassNo}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.delivery_place_class_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryPlaceClassName}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.delivery_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deliveryAddress}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.contacts LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.contacts}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.contacts_telephone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.contactsTelephone}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.org_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgNo}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.org_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.orgName}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.dept_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptNo}, '%')
AND t_delivery_place.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.deptName}, '%')
ORDER BY t_delivery_place.gmt_modified DESC
